description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding to the rear to be used as an annex, involving demolition of existing garage.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:1507-201507-301507-290 Rev C 1507-260 Rev C 1507-300 Rev C 1507-500 Rev C 1507-270 Rev C 1507-320 Rev C 1507-330 Rev C 1507-280 Rev C 1507-310 Rev C 1507-3451507-3351507-340Flood Risk Assessment and SUDS Proforma (AEG9141_EN3_Enfield) dated 02 July 20261507-00Planning Supportive Statement1507-510 Rev C Design & Access Statement1507-200 Rev C 1507-101507-210 Rev C Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.   Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

Prior to occupation of the development, a Verification Report demonstrating that the approved SuDS Flood Risk measures (AEG9141_EN3_Enfield_02 July 2026) have been fully implemented shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing. This report must include: o	As built drawings of the sustainable drainage systems including level information (if appropriate)o	Photographs of the completed sustainable drainage systemso	Any relevant certificates from manufacturers/ suppliers of any drainage featureso	A confirmation statement of the above signed by the site manager or similarREASON : To ensure the sustainable management of water, minimise flood risk, minimise discharge of surface water outside of the curtilage of the property and ensure that the drainage system will remain functional throughout the lifetime of the development in accordance with Policy CP28 of the Core Strategy, DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62, and Policies SI12 & SI13 of the London Plan and the NPPF.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing dwelling and shall not be used as an independent dwelling at any time.Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards, does not impact on neighbouring amenity and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality.
